summary: CarMax Auto Funding LLC, as depositor, disclosed the closing of a $— auto-loan ABS issuance by CarMax Select Receivables Trust 2026-C on September 28, 2026. Executed documents include an amended and restated trust agreement with Wilmington Trust as owner trustee, a grantor trust agreement, a receivables purchase agreement with CarMax Business Services, and a sale and servicing agreement. This is a routine structured-finance securitization takedown, not a corporate special situation. Watch pool composition, credit enhancement, and spread pricing rather than equity event risk.
